title: Effect of Bi(III)-to-metal ion concentration ratios on stripping voltammetric response of bismuth-film glassy carbon electrodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39361-39371
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07034H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hongwei Guo, Bin Chen, Yingmin Luo, Ruiyang Wang, Qichang Tian, Yanping Chang
The effect of cBi/cM ratio on key evaluation indicators, including sensitivity, precision, and cathodic potential range, has been investigated for the determination of Cd and Pb at in situ prepared bismuth film electrodes.
